npcs.name: Glirion the Redbeard
npcs.greet: Sit, sit. Nobody joins the Undaunted sober, and nobody leaves this table until the cask is dry or the floor is comfortable.

npcs.name: Maj al-Ragath
npcs.greet: Glirion sends me his drunks and calls them recruits. Prove me wrong about you, and do it before I finish this cup.

npcs.name: Urgarlag Chief-bane
npcs.greet: I killed a chief who deserved it and left a stronghold that didn't. Now I kill things in the dark for fun. You look like you might keep up.

relics.name: Broodmother's Fang
relics.desc: A hooked fang as long as a dagger, still beaded with venom. Glirion wants it for the trophy wall.

relics.name: Barrow-King's Torc
relics.desc: A twisted band of black iron, cold enough to sting the fingers. The dead king wore it for a few thousand years.

relics.name: Varla Stone of Malatar
relics.desc: An Ayleid star-stone humming with stored light. It pulses brighter whenever it is carried away from the ruin.

relics.name: Dreloth Funeral Mask
relics.desc: A carved bonemold mask from the Dreloth family niche. The grave-robber had already scraped the name off half of it.

relics.name: Sun-Idol of Mazzatun
relics.desc: A squat stone figure with jade eyes, worn smooth by the hands of a people who no longer come to pray.

relics.name: Volenfell Gyro-Core
relics.desc: A Dwemer heart of brass and spinning rings. It is still turning, and it is still warm.

relics.name: Horn of the Bromjunaar Warden
relics.desc: A war-horn of yellowed bone bound in bronze, taken from the deepest hall of Labyrinthian.

und_drinking_contest: Glirion slams two tankards on the table. The ale inside is dark, thick, and smells faintly of pine tar.
The rules are simple. We drink. Whoever's still upright at the end gets to talk. Whoever isn't gets carried.
Five tankards later, the hall is spinning and Glirion is singing a song about a troll and a bishop that has at least nine verses too many.
und_pledges_counted: Barrow, ruin, tomb, pyramid, Dwemer pit. Five pledges, five cultures, and you came back with all your fingers.
Most of them come back with fewer. Glirion lost a toe in Volenfell and still won't tell anyone how.
It was a gear. A very rude gear. Now, there's one delve left that none of us have finished, and I'd like to drink to it before we try.
und_legend: The three of them stand around the old horn as if it were a sleeping animal. Then Glirion hangs it on the trophy wall, in the empty space that has waited there for years.
Every Undaunted who ever lived has looked at that empty peg and lied about filling it. You didn't lie.
Don't let it go to your head. Your name goes on the wall. The next idiot has to beat it.

quests.title: Last One Standing
quests.offer: I hear the Undaunted take anyone who can survive a dungeon.
quests.pitch: Anyone who can survive a dungeon and a drinking contest, in that order or the other. Drink with me first. If you're still on your feet, there's a spider nest north of town that's been eating shepherds, and I need a fang off the mother.
quests.desc: Glirion the Redbeard, who keeps the Undaunted enclave in Daggerfall, invited me to join his band of delvers. His idea of an interview is a drinking contest followed by a spider nest.

objectives.text: Match Glirion tankard for tankard
objectives.reply: That's the spirit. Mind the third one, it bites back.

objectives.text: Finish the contest

choices.label: Drain the last tankard and slam it down.
choices.reply: Ha! Upright and smug about it. I like you already. Go and sleep it off on the road north.

choices.label: Quietly pour the last one into his potted fern.
choices.reply: That fern has been drunk since the Interregnum. You think I didn't see? Clever is good in a dungeon. Go on, then.

objectives.text: Find the spider cave called Spindleclutch
Clear the spiders out of Spindleclutch
objectives.journal: The broodmother had wrapped three shepherds and a mule in her silk. I didn't look too closely at what was left.

objectives.text: Pull a fang from the Broodmother
Bring the fang to Glirion in Daggerfall
objectives.topic: One fang, as requested. The nest is empty.
objectives.reply: Look at the size of it! That goes on the wall, and you go in the book. Welcome to the Undaunted. First round's on you next time.

quests.outro: I outlasted Glirion the Redbeard at the table, or near enough, and cleared Spindleclutch for him. The Undaunted wrote my name in their book.

quests.title: Pledge: The Barrow-King
quests.pitch: A promise to walk into a place everyone else walks away from. Your first is in Skyrim: Bleak Falls Barrow, above Riverwood. The Nords buried a king up there and he hasn't stopped sitting on his throne. Bring me his torc.
quests.desc: Glirion gave me my first Undaunted pledge: delve Bleak Falls Barrow in Skyrim and take the torc of the draugr king who still rules its lowest hall.

objectives.text: Travel to Bleak Falls Barrow in Skyrim
Fight through the barrow's restless dead
Defeat the Barrow-King on his throne
objectives.journal: The Barrow-King spoke one word as he rose. I didn't know it, but my ears rang for an hour afterwards.

objectives.text: Take the Barrow-King's torc
Bring the torc to Glirion
objectives.topic: The Barrow-King won't need this anymore.
objectives.reply: Cold, isn't it? Nordic iron never forgets what it was made for. One pledge down. Maj in Wayrest has the next, and she's in a mood, so bring your manners.

quests.outro: I fulfilled my first pledge in Bleak Falls Barrow and brought the Barrow-King's torc back to Daggerfall.

quests.title: Pledge: The Depths of Malatar
quests.offer: Glirion says you have a pledge for me.
quests.pitch: Garlas Malatar, in the Great Forest of Cyrodiil. The Ayleids built it to hold starlight, and something down there has been drinking it. Necromancers, most likely. Bring me the Varla stone from the lowest vault, and don't let it go dark.
quests.desc: Maj al-Ragath in Wayrest pledged me to the Ayleid ruin of Garlas Malatar in Cyrodiil, where necromancers are draining the old starlight from its stones.

objectives.text: Travel to Garlas Malatar in Cyrodiil
Purge the necromancers and their thralls from the ruin
Destroy the Light-Eater at the heart of the vault
objectives.journal: Ilvas had chained himself to the Varla stone with silver wire, as if the light could keep him young. It couldn't.

objectives.text: Take the Varla stone before it fades
Bring the Varla stone to Maj al-Ragath in Wayrest
objectives.topic: The stone's still lit. The thief isn't.
objectives.reply: Well. Glirion owes me five drakes. I bet you'd come back with a dark rock and a sad face. Urgarlag has the next pledge in Mournhold. She'll like you. Try not to encourage her.

quests.outro: I delved Garlas Malatar for Maj al-Ragath, ended a necromancer who was feeding on Ayleid starlight, and carried the Varla stone back to Wayrest still glowing.

quests.title: Pledge: The Dreloth Dead
quests.offer: Maj sent me. She says you're the fun one.
quests.pitch: She's lying, I'm the honest one. A grave-robber broke into the Dreloth family tomb outside Mournhold and woke up everything inside it. The Dunmer want their ancestors put back to sleep, and they want their mask back. Pledge accepted?
quests.desc: Urgarlag Chief-bane in Mournhold pledged me to the Dreloth Ancestral Tomb, a Velothi crypt where a grave-robber has stirred up the dead and stolen a funeral mask.

objectives.text: Find the Dreloth Ancestral Tomb outside Mournhold
Lay the angry ancestors back to rest
Kill the grave-robber
objectives.journal: Fendyn had a sack of grave goods and a very poor understanding of what the Dunmer do to people who rob their dead. The dead got to him before I did, almost.

objectives.text: Recover the stolen funeral mask
Report to Urgarlag in Mournhold
objectives.topic: The tomb is quiet. I have the mask.
objectives.reply: Good. Now the interesting part. The Undaunted keep trophies. The Dreloths want their mask. Nobody will ever know which you chose, except you.

objectives.text: Decide what becomes of the mask

choices.label: The mask goes back to the Dreloth family.
choices.reply: Hm. I'd have done the same, and then lied about it at the table. I'll see it's returned with your name attached.

choices.label: It's a trophy. I earned it.
choices.reply: Ha. Glirion will love it. Just don't wear it to Mournhold's temple, and don't sleep with it under your pillow.

quests.outro: I put the Dreloth ancestors back to sleep and killed the man who woke them. Urgarlag let me decide what to do with the stolen mask, and I decided.

quests.title: Pledge: The Stepped Pyramid
quests.pitch: Black Marsh. There's a xanmeer near Stormhold called Mazzatun, an old stepped pyramid the Argonians abandoned when their gods changed their minds. Something big nests on the top tier now. Bring back the sun-idol and we'll call it a pledge.
quests.desc: Urgarlag sent me into Black Marsh to climb the abandoned xanmeer of Mazzatun near Stormhold, where something large has made its nest, and bring back its sun-idol.

objectives.text: Travel to the Ruins of Mazzatun near Stormhold
Fight your way up the tiers of the xanmeer
Slay the old wamasu nesting at the summit
objectives.journal: Old Thunder-Jaw had been sleeping on the altar for so long that the stone had worn into the shape of its belly. The lightning in its throat lit the whole summit when it died.

objectives.text: Take the sun-idol from the summit altar
Bring the sun-idol to Urgarlag
objectives.topic: The pyramid is yours. The wamasu is somebody's boots, eventually.
objectives.reply: That's a pretty thing. Ugly, but pretty. There's one more before Glirion's big one. Maj wanted the Dwemer job for herself, but she's busy shouting at someone in Wayrest. Go and see her.

quests.outro: I climbed the xanmeer of Mazzatun, killed the wamasu that ruled its summit, and brought its sun-idol back to Urgarlag.

quests.title: Pledge: The Gears of Volenfell
quests.offer: Urgarlag says you have a Dwemer ruin for me.
quests.pitch: Volenfell, under the Alik'r sand. The Dwarves built it, my grandmother's people sealed it, and a band of fools has just unsealed it looking for gold. Their screams stopped a week ago. Go in, shut the machines down, and bring me the core that drives them.
quests.desc: Maj al-Ragath pledged me to Volenfell, a Dwemer city under the Alik'r Desert. Treasure-hunters reopened it and woke its machines.

objectives.text: Travel to Volenfell in the Alik'r Desert
Destroy the waking Dwemer machines
Bring down the Centurion guarding the core
objectives.journal: The Gate-Warden stood over the treasure-hunters' bodies, still guarding a door none of them had reached. When it fell, every machine in the city went still.

objectives.text: Take the gyro-core from the Centurion's cradle
Bring the gyro-core to Maj al-Ragath in Wayrest
objectives.topic: Volenfell is quiet again. Here is its heart.
objectives.reply: Still spinning. Dwemer work never knows when to quit. That's five pledges. Go to Daggerfall. Glirion has been saving something, and for once I think he's sober about it.

quests.outro: I shut down Volenfell's machines and brought its gyro-core to Maj al-Ragath. That was my fifth pledge: barrow, ruin, tomb, pyramid and Dwemer city.

quests.title: The Legendary Delve
quests.desc: Glirion, Maj and Urgarlag have one last delve none of them ever finished: the deepest hall of Labyrinthian in Skyrim, once called Bromjunaar, where an ancient warden still keeps the horn that called the Nords to war.

objectives.text: Speak with Glirion in Daggerfall
objectives.topic: Maj says you've been saving something.
objectives.reply: Labyrinthian. The old city of Bromjunaar. Every one of us has tried its lowest hall and every one of us came back carried. There's a warden down there with a horn, and there's an empty peg on our wall. Fill it.

objectives.text: Travel to Labyrinthian in Skyrim
Fight through the halls of Bromjunaar
Defeat the Warden of Bromjunaar
objectives.journal: The Warden blew his horn once as I came in. Every draugr in the hall answered. When he finally fell, the echo kept going for a long time.

objectives.text: Take the Warden's horn
Bring the horn home to the Daggerfall enclave
objectives.topic: Your peg's been empty long enough.
objectives.reply: By all the gods and a few of the princes. Maj! Urgarlag! Get in here, and bring the good cask.

quests.outro: I finished the delve no Undaunted had finished: the lowest hall of Labyrinthian. The Warden's horn hangs on the enclave wall in Daggerfall, and my name is carved beneath it.
